topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture topic and sets expectations regarding complement complexity and nomenclature.

topics.label: Fundamentals and central role of C3 in complement
topics.groupedBecause: They introduce the overall architecture, naming conventions, and central role of C3 cleavage in the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the initiation mechanisms and trigger threshold of the three pathways that activate complement on target surfaces.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: They explain the downstream effector functions through which activated complement destroys pathogens and drives inflammation.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the regulatory mechanisms that protect healthy host tissues from unintended complement activation.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: It details how deficiencies in specific complement components produce distinct clinical phenotypes and disease vulnerabilities.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion mechanisms and applications
topics.groupedBecause: It examines how pathogens evade complement-mediated destruction and highlights practical applications of bacterial evasion proteins.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: It provides closing remarks and previews the upcoming lecture on the adaptive immune system.
